title: Prepare final five-model native-memory 0.3.3 release payload
body:
Prepares the final five-model 0.3.3 native-memory release: all five generated adapter wheels, shared-runtime build 5, pinned GGUF loader, exact manifest/checksums and signature-enforcing draft-release tooling. Historical 0.3.2 evidence is retained. Updates active release, installation, compatibility and security documentation.

The current published testing application was validated in fresh owned fixtures on .253, with data and caches on .254: 2,314/2,314 checks passed (real Cognee 119, Vault 18, T1 207, T2 1,260, T3 710). T2/T3 include the additional receipt-health gates. All five final 0.3.3 adapters passed seven actual native cold/warm smoke checks each on one RX 7900 XTX, using existing NAS GGUFs and zero CPU weight offload. Exact runtime SHA and individual reports are included. Qwen Q4 uses the merged text-only architecture fix and 256 MiB preparation budget.

Application digest: sha256:e42752b9aafa9703ce9f11a703503a8bf0ea4fbe58dd6abbc8ccab5699904f0b. Both testing and testing-73cd98c resolve to it. PR #3013 changed documentation/artifacts and required no new application image. Current testing-head CI passed 56/56 jobs; main-merge preapproval builds passed and await approval. Full evidence: docs/validation/current-testing-release-2026-10-06.md.

Validation also includes eight release-verifier refusal/signature tests, actual seven-wheel hash verification, documentation checks and security-claim checks. Default release verification refuses the actual unsigned stage. Offline installation guidance requires the preinstalled GPU runtime and instructs no model downloads.

Ready for review and inclusion before PR #3003 promotion. Runtime validation found no blocker in the named profiles. The real native payload remains unsigned/unpublished: nine controlled-key signatures, publication and fresh installation from verified public downloads remain release gates. Short native smokes do not establish exhaustive checkpoint, lifecycle or performance qualification. Recorded fallback warnings remain documented.
head: release/native-memory-0.3.3-final
